summary: Insert a default only when a key is absent.
documentation: setdefault returns an existing value when the key is present. Otherwise it inserts and returns the supplied default. Unlike get, it can change the dictionary. Existing falsey values are preserved.
inputs: A key and optional default value.
returns: The existing or newly inserted value.
caution: A present None is not replaced. Copy the dictionary first when the caller’s original record must remain unchanged.
scenarios: Initialize a per-category collection before appending an item.
Fill absent configuration defaults without overriding explicit settings.
Keep a counter’s starting value for a newly encountered group.
title: Default a missing shipping method
problem: Input is an object. Return a copy with shipping set to pickup only when the shipping key is absent. Preserve every other field and keep an existing shipping value, including null or an empty string.
goal: Use dict.setdefault() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Copy the record and apply setdefault to shipping.
